dct_description_sm: This is a data schema created using Agri-food Data Canada's Semantic Engine . Data schemas describe data that are collected on an ongoing basis from research centres, and provide add-on documentation that enhances the value of raw data. This data schema is used for recording and managing disease diagnosis and treatment events for beef cattle. It captures information about veterinary treatments, including the diagnosis, treatment protocol, drug dose, route of administration, body weight, body temperature at the time of treatment, and meat withdrawal date. Data described in this schema is sample data, to request access to the related data, please visit the Ontario Beef Research Centre Data Portal.
